patch_description: Two improvements: (1) full greedy — at each step, evaluate ALL remaining transactions with the true makespan cost instead of a random sample of 6, so each greedy decision is fully informed; (2) local search — after each greedy construction, apply relocation/swap moves that reduce makespan until no improvement, repeated with randomized restarts under a time budget. This combines informed greedy construction with neighborhood-based refinement to lower makespan well below the current ~379.
